name: Wonderfold Clek Car Seat Adapter (Car Seat Adapter for Stroller Wagon)
seatBrandsSupported: Clek — the Clek variant is 'exclusively designed and safety tested to fit Clek car seats' (Clek Liing). Wonderfold sells the Car Seat Adapter in per-brand variants (Nuna / Cybex / Maxi-Cosi / Clek, plus Graco / UPPAbaby / Britax / Chicco); Clek's official list points to the Clek version, which is what this fragment represents.

status.clekNote: Clek's Liing/Liingo list names it simply 'Clek Car Seat Adapter' with no part number.

install.pieces: single-side adapter unit with safety strap
install.notes: Attaches to one side of the wagon (the other side stays open for a bench/seat); rotates 360 in 90-degree steps; folds down with the wagon. Up to TWO Clek adapters can be installed on W4 Elite/Luxe; only ONE on W2 models.

notes: This IS the 'Clek Car Seat Adapter' Clek names for the Wonderfold W4 / W2 Elite/Luxe wagons — the Clek-specific version is safety-tested for Clek seats (Liing). No part number appears on Clek's list or on Wonderfold's US product page (partNumber null). Price $94.99, in stock at Wonderfold DTC and Dillard's. Fitment: fits W2 Original+, W2 Elite/Luxe, all W4 wagons, W/W6 Pro and L Series; W4 Elite/Luxe accept two Clek adapters, W2 accepts one. Image is the Wonderfold Car Seat Adapter from the Wonderfold DTC listing (saved .jpg is a PNG file, per instructions).
